chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 416: Red Center — The Ultimate Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang reveals himself as Zuowandao’s Red Center in a brutal, grotesque twist—assassinating the Supervisor and reshaping his own face into the character 中.
og_title: The Mask of the Red Center Falls
og_description: Li Huowang betrays Zhuge Yuan and murders the Supervisor, unveiling himself as a high-ranking Zuowandao trickster.
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s shocking Zuowandao identity is exposed in a chapter of bloody betrayal and body horror.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking title within the Zuowandao, corresponding to the “red center” tile in mahjong. It marks the holder as one of the Four Joys.
The highest echelon of the Zuowandao, named after the four wind tiles or joy patterns in mahjong. Their appearance signals a major escalation in the sect’s operations.
An elite military unit in the Dao-Twisted World, reimagined here as a cover identity for Zuowandao operatives.
A mid-level official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office, often assigned as an overseer or handler; killed here by the Red Center.
